plan: An assassin leading a pack of dogs that leap onto her target.
aSurveiller: Her R (Hounds' Pursuit). She and her pack swoop onto a champion: when you are low on health, stay near your allies.
contrer: Stay near your allies: her dogs hurt a lot on an isolated target.
Kill her dogs with area spells: her pack deals her damage.
Use your crowd control after her E: she has no escape left.

sorts.W: Becomes untargetable and empowers her pack.
sorts.R: She and her pack swoop onto a champion.

momentFort: She has to farm first. Dangerous from level 6 with her R, and strong in the mid game.
